q: I got on her level, held her on the potty, and told her, "You're not going to fall in. Mama is holding you. Don't worry, Mama will never let her baby fall." Then she sat there an extra minute.

q: I didn’t see any mention of 3 days in the book tbh she actually repeats don’t focus on days focus on ‘blocks’.

cx: Oh Crap working, then a first poop accident when the routine changed.
